beats:
Halloween is a
shortened Scottish phrase.

All Hallows even.
The evening before
All Saints Day.

Hallow is an old word
for a saint. The short form
shows up in the 1560s.
Halloween means

the evening before
the saints' day.

Kids mailed real candy
to a cartoon boy.

In 1966, Charlie Brown
got a rock at every house.

Viewers felt so bad
they mailed piles of candy
to CBS.
A whole country

tried to fix
1 bad Halloween.

Autumn yellow was
in the leaf all summer.

Green chlorophyll covers it
through the growing season.

As nights lengthen,
the green breaks down
and the yellow shows.
Fall color

is what remains
when the green fades.

Scottish children went
door to door by the 1500s.

It was called guising.
They went out in disguise.

Neighbors gave them treats
to ward off harmful spirits.
The costume came first,
as quiet protection.

Ghostbusters opens
in a library.

In 2015 it was added
to the Library of Congress
film registry.

The director pointed out
it begins with a ghost
in a library.
Full circle,
right back to the stacks.

The wer in werewolf
is an old word for man.

Old English werewulf.
Wer, man. Wulf, wolf.

The word faded after the 1600s
and came back in the 1800s.
Word for word,
a man wolf.

Bobbing for apples
was a way to find a spouse.

The first to pull out an apple
would marry first.

Some slept with the apple
under the pillow, to dream
of who it would be.
A party game
with a real question in it.

Monster Mash hit No. 1
in October 1962.

The BBC banned it
as too morbid.

It climbed the charts again
in 1970 and in 1973.
A silly song
kept finding its way home.

The best scare
sits in the middle.

Researchers put heart monitors
on 110 visitors
to a haunted attraction.

Fun peaked at moderate fear,
and dropped when it was
too little or too much.
Fear turns into fun
inside a narrow window.

Candy corn began
in the 1880s.

In 1898 it was sold
as Chicken Feed.

Each colored layer
was once poured by hand.
A seasonal sweet
began as a nod to farm life.

The scariest mask of 1978
started as Captain Kirk.

It was a William Shatner mask,
painted white.

The sideburns came off.
The eyeholes were cut wider.
A hero's face, emptied out,
became the fear.

An owl's feathers
are shaped to erase sound.

Comb-like edges break up
the air behind the wing.

A soft, velvety surface
absorbs what is left.
Silence
is built into the feather.

Mischief Night first shows up
in writing at Oxford, 1790.

It was May Day eve then.
Shop signs got swapped.

Now it is Cabbage Night
in parts of New England,
Devil's Night in Detroit.
The urge to prank
just changed dates.

The book you traded at recess
topped a banned list.

Scary Stories was
the most challenged book
of the 1990s.

It ranked above
every other title
for the decade.
What scared the adults most
was the book itself.

To haunt a place
first meant to visit it often.

From Old French hanter,
to frequent.

The ghostly sense shows up
in Shakespeare, around 1590.
A ghost haunts a house

the way a regular
haunts a cafe.

One town answered
pranks with a parade.

Soaped windows.
Tipped outhouses.
Cows on Main Street.

In 1920, Anoka, Minnesota
gave its kids a parade
and a bonfire.
Every year since,
except 1942 and 1943.

Your porch pumpkin's family
was farmed 10,000 years ago.

Seeds and rind were found
in a cave in Oaxaca, Mexico.

Farmed earlier
than maize or beans.
And yes, it is a fruit.
One of the oldest
crops in the Americas.

Wartime Halloween ran on
popcorn balls and cider.

Sugar was among the first
groceries rationed
in World War II.

Newspapers printed
ration friendly recipes
before the holiday.
People kept the holiday
by changing what they baked.

Thriller was the first
music video the Library
of Congress kept.

It joined the National
Film Registry in 2009.

1 of 25 films
chosen that year
for preservation.
The graveyard dance
is officially history.

Most faces we see
in objects read as male.

Faces in outlets, clouds
and pumpkins have a name.
Face pareidolia.

In a study of 3,815 adults,
90% of these faces
were rated male.
The brain gives a pattern
a whole personality.

Robert Burns explained
Halloween fortune telling
in 16 footnotes.

His poem Halloween
was published in 1786.

Pulling kail stalks eyes shut.
An apple before a mirror
by candlelight.
He wrote the rituals down
so they would not be lost.

Halloween's autumn town
was filmed in a
Los Angeles spring.

Haddonfield was built
from Los Angeles locations
in spring 1978.

With about $300,000,
they could not travel
to find real autumn.
The fall you remember
was made in sunshine.

Your goosebumps are built
for fur you no longer have.

Thick fur traps warmth.
Humans barely benefit.

In mice, the same cells
help regrow hair.
A leftover reflex
that still has work to do.

In 1999, theaters handed out
missing person flyers.

The filmmakers asked audiences
for information about
the 3 students.

Those materials are now held
by a university library.
The scare began
before the lights went down.

A bonfire was once,
quite literally, a bone fire.

In the late 1300s it was
bonfir or banefire.

A fire for burning bones.
Forgotten by the 1700s.
The word began
as bone plus fire.

The first Treehouse of Horror
ended with Edgar Allan Poe.

October 25, 1990.
An earnest telling
of The Raven.

James Earl Jones narrated.
Bart was the bird.
A cartoon gave kids
their first Poe.

Before candy,
there were soul cakes.

Small spiced cakes,
marked with a cross.

The poor went door to door
and were given the cakes.
Asking at the door
began as feeding the poor.

The Owens house
in Practical Magic
was mostly hollow.

It was built on bare land
in Washington state.

It came down the day after
filming wrapped.
The house we all wanted
only stood for a season.

Day of the Dead grew
from 2 sets of roots.

Aztec, Toltec, Olmec and Maya
traditions saw death
as life continuing.

Those rituals blended with
All Saints and All Souls.
Death as a continuation,
not an ending.

A French abbot gave the dead
their own day.

Odilo of Cluny set
November 2 for prayer
for all the dead.

By the late 1200s it was kept
almost everywhere
in the Western church.
Remembering the dead
became a shared act.
